instructions_to_main_agent: Use English for all text. The architecture should be parametrizable for Spanish later, but output the MVP in English.
Do NOT create an About Us section.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts in marketing sections. Use Shadcn exclusively for interactive components like the Contact Form inputs/buttons.
Ensure 'Outfit' font is used for Headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for Body text. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for small tech labels.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, forms).
Contact form must send email to 'lalogalindo@gmail.com' via Resend and include reCAPTCHA v2.
Use a deep dark background (#050510) and apply the brand colors (Cyan, Magenta, Lime, Orange, Red) as subtle gradients, glowing borders, or text-clip effects.
All containers/cards must have generous padding (p-6, p-8) and subtle white/10 borders to simulate crystal glassmorphism.
Hero overlay must be max bg-black/60 to let the background abstract image shine through.
In the Process section, make sure to strongly highlight that 'requirements gathering is our primary focus'.
Do not include social media links in the footer, only copyright and phone number (2221401900).
Remember to include Privacy Policy and Data Usage section as a scannable legal section.
